experiments.title: Give one late facility an extension
experiments.plain: Facility F11 normally misses the 15 December deadline. Its return is made due on 31 December instead.
experiments.predict: Does F11 still get a T-3 reminder and an overdue escalation? Does the final report still wait for it?
experiments.look_for: F11 drops out of the T-3 and overdue drafts and gets a T-14 reminder for its new date instead; its return is then accepted on time, so two fewer drafts are written. The final report still waits on 18 December - F11 is now "open" rather than "overdue". Nothing about the other ten facilities changes.

edits.sql: UPDATE assignment SET due_at = '2026-12-31' WHERE assignment_id = '2026Q4-F11'

experiments.title: Point a facility at a coordinator who does not exist
experiments.plain: Facility F01's assignment is given coordinator C9, who is not in the coordinator table.
experiments.predict: Will the database accept it? If it does, who would the reminder go to?
experiments.look_for: The database refuses the change - the coordinator link is a foreign key it enforces - so the run carries on exactly as normal. A constraint stops bad data before any code has to.

edits.sql: PRAGMA foreign_keys = ON; UPDATE assignment SET coordinator_id = 'C9' WHERE assignment_id = '2026Q4-F01'
